title: 322 Taiwanese Farm Products Escape New US Tariffs
summaryZh: 美國新關稅豁免台灣322項農產品
summaryHi: अमेरिका के नए टैरिफ़ से ताइवान के 322 कृषि उत्पादों को छूट मिली।
summaryEs: 322 productos agrícolas de Taiwán quedan exentos de los nuevos aranceles de EE. UU.
summaryJa: 台湾の農産品322品目、米国の追加関税を免除。
summaryKo: 대만 농산물 322개 품목, 미국 추가 관세 면제.
summaryEn: Taiwan says 322 of its farm products will stay free of extra US tariffs under Washington's latest trade plan.
paragraphs: Taiwanese farmers received welcome news on Thursday when Agriculture Minister Chen Chun-chi announced that 322 agricultural products would remain exempt from additional US tariffs.

The announcement follows a proposal by the Office of the US Trade Representative to impose tariffs of up to 15 percent on Taiwanese goods. The move is part of an investigation into 14 economies whose industrial policies, Washington argues, have created structural overcapacity. If talks prove unsatisfactory, the rate could rise to as much as 25 percent.

The exempt products account for 36 to 40 percent of Taiwan's agricultural export value to the US. Twenty-six of them, including moth orchids and anthuriums, enjoy exemptions specific to Taiwan, giving growers a clear edge over foreign rivals. Taiwanese orchids enter the US duty-free, whereas Dutch competitors pay 10 percent.
To cushion any impact, the ministry has earmarked NT$18 billion from a special resilience budget for exporters and plans to expand its NT$30 billion Agricultural Safety Fund.
The proposals are not yet final. Public hearings in the US are due to begin in January, and Taipei hopes the outcome will match its existing trade agreement with Washington.
Taiwan sells many farm products to the United States. Now there is good news for farmers. The US will not add new taxes on 322 of these products.
A tax on things from another country is called a tariff. The US is checking trade with 14 places, like China, Japan and Taiwan. It wants to stop countries from making too many goods.
Taiwan's farm minister, Chen Chun-chi, shared the news on Thursday. The 322 products are about 36 to 40 percent of Taiwan's farm sales to the US.

Some Taiwanese products now have a big price advantage. Taiwanese orchids pay no tax in the US. Orchids from the Netherlands pay 10 percent. Fish called tilapia from Taiwan pay 10 percent, but tilapia from China pay 37.5 percent.
The government will also give NT$18 billion to help farmers sell their food abroad.
sentZh: 台灣賣很多農產品給美國。
現在農民有好消息。
美國不會對其中322項產品加徵新稅。
對來自其他國家的東西課的稅叫做關稅。
美國正在檢查與14個地方的貿易，例如中國、日本和台灣。
它想阻止各國生產太多商品。
台灣的農業部長陳駿季在星期四公布了這個消息。
這322項產品約占台灣對美農產品銷售的36%到40%。
有些台灣產品現在有很大的價格優勢。
台灣蘭花在美國不用繳稅。
來自荷蘭的蘭花要繳10%。
台灣的吳郭魚繳10%，但中國的吳郭魚要繳37.5%。
政府也會拿出180億新台幣，幫助農民把食物賣到國外。

paragraphs: Good news arrived for Taiwan's farmers this week. Agriculture Minister Chen Chun-chi said on Thursday that 322 Taiwanese farm products will not face any extra tariffs in the United States.

The US is running an investigation into 14 economies, including China, Japan, South Korea, the EU and Taiwan. It says their government policies have helped factories produce far more goods than the world needs. As a result, the US has proposed new tariffs of up to 15 percent on many Taiwanese goods.

However, the 322 farm products are protected. Together they make up between 36 and 40 percent of the value of Taiwan's farm exports to the US. Twenty-six of them, such as moth orchids, have special exemptions just for Taiwan.
These exemptions give Taiwanese farmers an advantage. For example, Taiwanese edamame beans face a 10 percent tariff, while Chinese edamame faces 41.3 percent.
The ministry has also set aside NT$18 billion to support exporters. The final tariff decision is expected early next year.
sentZh: 本週台灣農民迎來好消息。
農業部長陳駿季星期四表示，台灣有322項農產品在美國不會被加徵任何額外關稅。
美國正在對14個經濟體進行調查，包括中國、日本、南韓、歐盟和台灣。
美方說，這些經濟體的政府政策讓工廠生產的商品遠超過世界所需。
因此，美國提議對許多台灣商品課徵最高15%的新關稅。
不過，這322項農產品受到保護。
它們合計占台灣對美農產品出口總值的36%到40%。
其中26項，例如蝴蝶蘭，享有台灣專屬的豁免。
這些豁免讓台灣農民占有優勢。
例如，台灣毛豆的關稅是10%，而中國毛豆則是41.3%。
農業部也撥出180億新台幣支持出口業者。
最終的關稅決定預計在明年初出爐。

sentZh: 農業部長陳駿季星期四宣布，322項農產品將持續免徵美國的額外關稅，讓台灣農民收到好消息。
這項宣布是在美國貿易代表署提議對台灣商品課徵最高15%關稅之後。
此舉是對14個經濟體調查的一部分，華府認為這些經濟體的產業政策造成了結構性產能過剩。
如果談判結果不理想，稅率可能升高到25%。
這些豁免產品占台灣對美農產品出口值的36%到40%。
其中26項，包括蝴蝶蘭和火鶴花，享有台灣專屬的豁免，讓種植者比外國對手擁有明顯優勢。
台灣蘭花免稅進入美國，而荷蘭競爭者則要繳10%。
為了減緩衝擊，農業部已從特別韌性預算中撥出180億新台幣給出口業者，並計畫擴大規模300億新台幣的農業安全基金。
這些提案還不是最終版本。
美國的公聽會預定明年一月開始，台北希望結果能與現有的對美貿易協定一致。

paragraphs: Taiwan's agricultural sector has been spared the worst of Washington's latest trade offensive. Agriculture Minister Chen Chun-chi confirmed on Thursday that 322 farm products will continue to enter the United States without any additional tariffs.

His remarks came a day after the US Trade Representative unveiled proposed duties of up to 15 percent on Taiwanese goods, the outcome of a Section 301 probe into what it calls structural excess capacity across 14 economies. Should consultations falter, the ceiling could climb to 25 percent.

The shielded items represent roughly 36 to 40 percent of the value of Taiwan's farm exports to the US, and 26 of them benefit from Taiwan-specific carve-outs. The resulting price gaps are striking: Taiwanese tilapia faces a 10 percent levy, compared with 37.5 percent for its Chinese counterpart.
Even so, the ministry is hedging its bets. It has ring-fenced NT$18 billion from a special resilience budget to support exporters and intends to enlarge its NT$30 billion Agricultural Safety Fund.
Vice Premier Cheng Li-chiun stressed that nothing will be settled until the US process concludes early next year, with Taipei pressing for terms consistent with its reciprocal trade agreement.
sentZh: 台灣農業部門躲過了華府最新貿易攻勢中最嚴重的衝擊。
農業部長陳駿季星期四證實，322項農產品將繼續免徵任何額外關稅進入美國。
他發言的前一天，美國貿易代表署公布了對台灣商品最高15%的擬議關稅，這是一項針對14個經濟體所謂「結構性產能過剩」的301條款調查結果。
如果磋商不順，上限可能攀升到25%。
這些受保護的品項約占台灣對美農產品出口值的36%到40%，其中26項享有台灣專屬的例外條款。
由此產生的價差相當驚人：台灣吳郭魚的稅率是10%，而中國吳郭魚是37.5%。
即便如此，農業部仍在預留後路。
它已從特別韌性預算中專款保留180億新台幣支持出口業者，並打算擴大300億新台幣的農業安全基金。
副院長鄭麗君強調，在美國程序明年初結束之前，一切都還沒定案，台北將力爭符合雙方對等貿易協定的條件。

paragraphs: For Taiwan's farmers, the latest round of American trade measures has delivered an unexpected reprieve. On Thursday, Agriculture Minister Chen Chun-chi announced that 322 agricultural products would remain exempt from any additional US tariffs.

The exemption must be viewed against a broader backdrop. A day earlier, the US Trade Representative had proposed tariffs of up to 15 percent on Taiwanese imports, following an investigation into 14 economies accused of fostering structural overcapacity through industrial subsidies. Officials also warned that the rate could escalate to 25 percent if negotiations proved unsatisfactory.

The protected goods are economically significant, accounting for between 36 and 40 percent of Taiwan's agricultural export value to the US. Moreover, 26 items, notably moth orchids, enjoy country-specific exemptions, which confer a considerable competitive advantage. Taiwanese edamame, for instance, is subject to a 10 percent duty, whereas Chinese producers face 41.3 percent.

Nevertheless, the government is taking precautions. It has allocated NT$18 billion from a special resilience budget to assist exporters and intends to expand its NT$30 billion Agricultural Safety Fund.
Ultimately, the arrangement remains provisional. Public hearings in Washington are scheduled for January, and Taipei will seek an outcome consistent with its existing reciprocal trade agreement.
sentZh: 對台灣農民而言，美國最新一輪貿易措施帶來了意外的喘息機會。
星期四，農業部長陳駿季宣布，322項農產品將持續免徵任何額外的美國關稅。
這項豁免必須放在更廣泛的背景下來看。
前一天，美國貿易代表署提議對台灣進口商品課徵最高15%的關稅，起因是一項針對14個經濟體的調查，這些經濟體被指控透過產業補貼助長結構性產能過剩。
官員也警告，如果談判結果不理想，稅率可能升高到25%。
這些受保護的商品在經濟上意義重大，占台灣對美農產品出口值的36%到40%。
此外，26項品項（特別是蝴蝶蘭）享有國家專屬的豁免，帶來相當大的競爭優勢。
例如，台灣毛豆的關稅為10%，而中國生產者則要面對41.3%。
儘管如此，政府仍在採取預防措施。
它已從特別韌性預算中撥出180億新台幣協助出口業者，並打算擴大300億新台幣的農業安全基金。
說到底，這項安排仍是暫時性的。
華府的公聽會預定在一月舉行，台北將尋求與現有對等貿易協定一致的結果。

noteHi.exampleTr: छोटी दुकानों को नए कर से छूट मिली।
